title: Generator-normalized consecutive open scalar restriction
statement: Fix a prime ell, a finite extension E of Q_ell in an independent coefficient universe, an open immersion j:X -> V, and the coefficient-system transports and open operations o [lem-sf-integral-open-reduction-comparison]. Write B_(W,k)=(O_E/varpi^(k+1))_W and S_n^W=Res_(B_(W,n+1)->B_(W,n)) [def-coef-normalized-dvr-tower], and J_k for the finite open extension. For each n >= 0 there is an ordinary natural isomorphism S_n^X followed by J_(n+1) isomorphic to J_n followed by S_n^V. On every extension summand it sends a section to the generator with that same underlying section. The assertion is expressed as HEq of the two functions on the native section carriers.

proof.text: Apply naturality of the recorded system ring map to the horizontal arrow (n+1,W) to (n,W). Its component normalization identifies this equation with the square of the two finite ring maps and their coefficient quotients. The concrete pushforward composition and congruence isomorphisms give S_n^X followed by the (n+1)-slice transport isomorphic to the n-slice transport followed by slice scalar restriction; all maps retain the underlying sections.

Apply [lem-cbc-ringed-open-scalar-adjunction] to the consecutive ring quotient on the ambient site. Invert its extension/scalar comparison and compose with the transport square from Step 1. This constructs e_n. The comparison generator formula and sectionwise identity transport prove exactly [x]_a maps to [x]_a. The generator formula also uniquely specifies this ordinary comparison.

theorem integralOpenScalarRestrictionComparison (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ ordinary : normalizedDVRModuleRes l E X (Nat.le_succ n) ⋙
          IntegralOpenReduction.finiteExtension l E j o (n + 1) ≅
        IntegralOpenReduction.finiteExtension l E j o n ⋙
          normalizedDVRModuleRes l E V (Nat.le_succ n),
      ∀ (M : normalizedDVRModules l E X n) (W : V.ProEt)
        (a : W ⟶ IntegralOpenReduction.openObject j),
        HEq (fun x : ((normalizedDVRModuleRes l E X (Nat.le_succ n)).obj M).val.obj
            (op ((IntegralOpenReduction.sliceSite j).obj (Over.mk a))) ↦
          (ordinary.hom.app M).val.app (op W)
            (IntegralOpenReduction.finiteExtensionSection l E j o (n + 1)
              ((normalizedDVRModuleRes l E X (Nat.le_succ n)).obj M) W a x))
          (fun x : M.val.obj (op ((IntegralOpenReduction.sliceSite j).obj (Over.mk a))) ↦
            IntegralOpenReduction.finiteExtensionSection l E j o n M W a x)
